caption: The drawing features a pale blue background with a subtle marbled texture. Along the top edge, there is a horizontal decorative border composed of orange and red flowers with green leaves and brown stems, interspersed with light gray curling lines. Beneath this border, a thin, solid yellow line runs horizontally. The main section of the drawing is filled with a scattered floral pattern consisting of small, stylized flowers in shades of yellow, orange, and red, with black and gray outlines and accents. The flowers are separated by fine, curving black stems and leaves, as well as smaller, abstract black linear shapes. On the left side of the composition, a vertical border runs parallel to the edge, made up of a green wavy line with small green circular motifs inside its curves. The entire design is composed of organic, flowing shapes and the overall palette is dominated by blue, green, yellow, orange, red, black, and gray tones.
title: Wall Decoration
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
